title: Checkout and receipts
outcome: Keep the counter flow focused on finding items, reviewing a basket, and completing a sale.
planned_scope: Product search, barcode flow, cart review, payment handling, receipt history, and sharing—only as each workflow is implemented and validated.

title: Inventory and stock movement
outcome: Make stock changes traceable instead of hiding them in a single number.
planned_scope: Catalogue, SKU/barcode, retail units, stock balances, low-stock signals, and movement history.

title: Till and cash control
outcome: Help a manager understand what should be in the till at the end of a shift.
planned_scope: Shift opening/closing, expected-versus-counted cash, cash-in/out, and a clear movement trail.

title: Offline operation and sync
outcome: Design for unreliable connectivity without pretending disconnected devices can see one another's sales.
planned_scope: Local data, durable queued operations, safe retries, reconnect behavior, and visible reconciliation when stock conflicts occur.

title: Roles and device access
outcome: Give each person and admitted device only the access their job requires.
planned_scope: Role-aware workflows, device admission/revocation, and recovery paths, subject to implementation and testing.

title: Customers, suppliers, and reports
outcome: Bring everyday retail records together so managers can follow transactions and operational activity.
planned_scope: Customer/supplier records, purchases, linked transaction history, and operational reporting.
